title: VerificationGuarantee
description:
Per-backend SHA-256 verification guarantee.

Describes how the server validates `expected_sha256` for each backend.

oneOf.description:
Server independently computes SHA-256 from stored object data.

Currently used only for the `Local` backend, which reads from the server's local filesystem (zero egress cost, no SDK limitation).
Server passes the client-declared SHA-256 to the backend at commit time; the backend rejects the commit on mismatch.
Client declares SHA-256 at upload init; the server has no independent verification path for this backend.
